title: Beef Stroganoff
description: A large-batch beef stroganoff of sauteed beef, onions and carrots in a thickened non-dairy beef sauce with wide egg noodles, packed in pans for freezing.

items.notes: printed 'tsb'; ambiguous between teaspoon and tablespoon

steps.instruction: Boil water, remove from heat, add noodles, stir, cover and let stand for 15 to 20 minutes. Cool under running water and drain.
Sautee onions to golden brown and drain.
Boil carrots in water. Drain but use drained liquid for beef stock.
Sautee beef cubes, cool and using food processor slice into 1/8 inch pieces or slice by hand (tedious).
Boil water add beef broth, white pepper, garlic, Coffee Rich, ketchup and any drippings from sautéed beef.
Add potato starch to beef broth and thicken.
Combine all ingredients and place in 10 x 13 inch pans. Cover and freeze.

notes: Prepared ahead and frozen in 10 x 13 inch pans; the original gives no cooking (reheating) instructions.
